name: Early Career Exploration Institute, Middlesex County Magnet Schools
city: East Brunswick, Perth Amboy and Piscataway, NJ
what_you_do: Try career and technical education in a free summer program. It has classes and hands-on projects. It ends with a gallery walk.
who_can_apply: Any Middlesex County student who finished 7th grade and is going into 8th grade. You should like the idea of career and tech classes.
pay_detail: Free. Students provide their own transportation.
duration: 12 days: July 6 to 23 in 2026, Monday to Thursday
deadline_text: The 2026 session ran July 6 to 23, 2026 and was at capacity (waiting list only). 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: In 2026 the page offered a waiting list form. Watch the Magnet Schools site for the 2027 sign up.
notes: For younger teens only: students must have just finished 7th grade.
